# ZORUX FRAMEWORK — LLM REFERENCE

Zorux is an AI-first full-stack framework. A single `app.yaml` generates REST API, Admin UI, Mobile (Expo), Desktop (Tauri), PWA, GraphQL, Webhooks, Background Jobs, Auth (35 OAuth providers), Payments, Real-time WebSocket, and more.

**Key principle:** Describe your app in YAML. Zorux generates everything. Zero boilerplate. ~500 tokens vs ~5,000 for traditional frameworks.

---

## QUICK START

```bash
npm install -g zorux
zorux new my-app --saas
cd my-app
zorux dev
```

Server runs at `http://localhost:3000`:
- API: `http://localhost:3000/api`
- Admin: `http://localhost:3000/admin`
- Swagger: `http://localhost:3000/api/docs`
- WebSocket: `ws://localhost:3000/ws`

---

## YAML SCHEMA (app.yaml)

The single source of truth. Every model, auth config, database, plugin defined here.

### Top-Level

```yaml
name: string                    # App name
type: api | web | mobile | fullstack  # App type
provider: string                # Platform provider (default: "Zorux")
database: DatabaseDef           # Database config
models: Record<string, ModelDef>  # Model definitions
auth: AuthDef                   # Auth configuration
routes: Record<string, any>     # Custom routes
realtime: RealtimeDef           # WebSocket config
theme: ThemeDef                 # UI theme
supabase: SupabaseDef           # Supabase integration
storage: StorageDef             # File storage
plugins: string[]               # Plugin names
pluginConfig: PluginConfig      # Per-plugin config
cache: CacheDef                 # Cache configuration
i18n: I18nDef                   # Internationalization
email: EmailDef                 # Email provider
payments: PaymentsDef           # Payment provider
search: SearchDef               # Search engine
captcha: CaptchaDef             # Captcha config
```

### Database

```yaml
database:
  provider: sqlite              # sqlite | postgres | mysql | mongodb | cloudflare-d1 | cf-d1 | supabase | :memory:
  url: string                   # Connection string (for non-SQLite)
```

### Models

```yaml
models:
  Post:
    fields:
      title: string required min:3 max:200
      slug: string unique
      body: text required
      status: string enum:draft,published,archived default:draft
      price: float min:0
      count: int
      active: bool
      coverImage: file
      author: User              # belongsTo — creates authorId FK
      tags: Tag[]               # manyToMany
    timestamps: true            # Auto created_at/updated_at (default: true)
    policies:                   # ABAC/RBAC policies
      list: public
      read: public
      create: authenticated
      update: "resource.authorId == user.id"
      delete: "user.role == 'admin'"
    fieldPolicies:              # Field-level access
      - field: price
        readable: "user.role == 'admin'"
        writable: "user.role == 'admin'"
    derivedRoles:               # Dynamic roles
      - name: editor
        condition: "user.role == 'admin' || user.role == 'editor'"
    scoped: true                # Multi-tenant (org-scoped)
    id: int | uuid              # ID type (default: int)
    softDelete: true            # Soft delete with deleted_at
```

### Field Types

| Type | Description | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|
| `string` | VARCHAR(255) | required, unique, min:N, max:N, default:val, pattern:regex, enum:a,b,c |
| `text` | TEXT | required, default:val |
| `int` | INTEGER | required, min:N, max:N, default:val |
| `float` | REAL/FLOAT | required, min:N, max:N, default:val |
| `bool` | BOOLEAN | required, default:val |
| `email` | VARCHAR with email validation | required, unique |
| `file` | File upload field | required |

### Relations

```yaml
author: User              # belongsTo — creates authorId INTEGER FK
tags: Tag[]               # manyToMany — creates join table
comments: Comment[]       # hasMany — creates postId on Comment
```

### Auth Configuration

```yaml
auth:
  model: User                 # Auth model name
  registration: open          # open | invite | admin
  roles: [admin, editor, user]
  defaultRole: user
  passwordMinLength: 8
  sessionExpiry: 24           # hours
  refreshTokenExpiry: 30      # days
  social:
    google:
      clientId: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}
      clientSecret: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}
    github:
      clientId: ${GITHUB_CLIENT_ID}
      clientSecret: ${GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET}
  organization:
    enabled: true
    roles: [owner, admin, member]
    inviteExpiresIn: 7
```

### Policies (ABAC)

Operators: `==`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `&&`, `||`, `!`, `in`, `matches`, `contains`, `exists`

Scopes: `user.*` (current user), `resource.*` (target resource), `env.*` (environment)

```yaml
policies:
  list: public                                    # Anyone
  read: authenticated                             # Logged in
  create: "user.role == 'admin'"                  # Role check
  update: "resource.authorId == user.id"          # Ownership
  delete: "user.role == 'admin' || resource.authorId == user.id"  # Combined
```

### Cache

```yaml
cache:
  provider: memory              # memory | redis | upstash | memcached | dynamodb | sqlite | cf-kv | cf-do
  url: string
  ttl: 60                       # seconds
```

### Storage

```yaml
storage:
  provider: local               # local | s3
  s3:
    endpoint: string
    region: string
    bucket: string
    accessKey: string
    secretKey: string
    publicUrl: boolean
```

### Email

```yaml
email:
  provider: fake                # fake | log | resend | sendgrid | smtp
  from: "noreply@myapp.com"
  resend:
    apiKey: string
  sendgrid:
    apiKey: string
  smtp:
    host: string
    port: number
    secure: boolean
    user: string
    pass: string
```

### Payments

```yaml
payments:
  provider: stripe              # stripe | polar
  stripe:
    secretKey: string
    webhookSecret: string
  polar:
    token: string
```

### Search

```yaml
search:
  provider: meilisearch
  url: string
  apiKey: string
```

### Captcha

```yaml
captcha:
  provider: turnstile           # turnstile | recaptcha
  siteKey: string
  secretKey: string
```

### i18n

```yaml
i18n:
  defaultLocale: en
  locales: [en, pt-BR, es, fr]
  cookieName: lang
```

### Theme

```yaml
theme:
  framework: tailwind           # default | tailwind | daisyui | antd | mui | chakra | mantine | headless
  primary: "#3b82f6"
  mode: dark                    # light | dark | auto
  font: Inter
  radius: 0.5rem
```

### Real-time

```yaml
realtime:
  enabled: true
  channels:
    posts: "posts.*"
    comments: "comments.*"
```

## CLI COMMANDS

```bash
zorux new <name> [--api|--web|--mobile|--fullstack|--saas|--all] [--ui <framework>]
zorux dev [port]                          # Dev server with hot reload
zorux gen mobile                          # Generate Expo app
zorux gen desktop                         # Generate Tauri app
zorux gen pwa                             # Generate PWA
zorux gen graphql                         # Generate GraphQL client
zorux add model <Name> <field>:<type> [flags...]
zorux make action <name> <handler1> [handler2...]
zorux make job <name>
zorux make migration <name>
zorux seed [--count N] [Model:N...]
zorux db reset                            # Delete SQLite database
zorux db migrate [--auto]                 # Run migrations
zorux db rollback                         # Rollback last batch
zorux db status                           # Show migration status
zorux db schema dump                      # Dump schema to SQL
zorux deploy [docker|vercel|netlify|cloudflare]
zorux test [--run|--e2e|--security]
zorux audit                               # Security audit
zorux info                                # Project info
zorux docs [topic]                        # Open documentation
zorux scaffold forum|blog|ecommerce|saas [name]
zorux console                             # Interactive REPL
zorux runner <script>                     # Run custom script
zorux plugin list|add|remove
zorux credentials setup|edit|show
zorux version
zorux completion bash|zsh|fish
```

## API ENDPOINTS

All models auto-generate CRUD at `/api/{tableName}`:

### CRUD

```
GET    /api/posts                    # List (page, limit, search, sort, order)
POST   /api/posts                    # Create
GET    /api/posts/:id                # Get by ID
PUT    /api/posts/:id                # Update
DELETE /api/posts/:id                # Delete
POST   /api/posts/bulk               # Bulk create
PUT    /api/posts/bulk               # Bulk update
DELETE /api/posts/bulk               # Bulk delete
GET    /api/posts/export?format=json|csv|xlsx
POST   /api/posts/import             # JSON/CSV/XLSX upload
```

### Soft Delete (if softDelete: true)

```
POST   /api/posts/:id/restore        # Restore
DELETE /api/posts/:id/permanent      # Hard delete
```

### Query Parameters

| Param | Description |
|---|---|
| `page` | Page number (default: 1) |
| `limit` | Items per page (max: 100, default: 20) |
| `search` | Full-text search |
| `sort` | Field to sort by |
| `order` | asc or desc |
| `include` | Comma-separated relations |

### Auth Endpoints

```
POST   /api/auth/register            # Register
POST   /api/auth/login               # Login
GET    /api/auth/me                  # Current user
POST   /api/auth/refresh             # Refresh token
POST   /api/auth/forgot-password     # Request reset
POST   /api/auth/reset-password      # Confirm reset
POST   /api/auth/send-verification   # Send verification
GET    /api/auth/verify-email?token= # Verify email
POST   /api/auth/magic-link/send     # Send magic link
GET    /api/auth/magic-link?token=   # Login via link
POST   /api/auth/otp/send            # Send OTP
POST   /api/auth/otp/verify          # Verify OTP
POST   /api/auth/api-keys            # Create API key
GET    /api/auth/api-keys            # List keys
DELETE /api/auth/api-keys/:id        # Revoke key
POST   /api/auth/2fa/setup           # Setup TOTP
POST   /api/auth/2fa/confirm         # Confirm TOTP
POST   /api/auth/2fa/disable         # Disable TOTP
GET    /api/auth/sessions            # List sessions
DELETE /api/auth/sessions/:id        # Revoke session
POST   /api/auth/sessions/revoke-all # Revoke all
```

### Social Auth

## AUTHENTICATION

### Methods

1. **Email/Password** — bcrypt via `Bun.password.hash()`
2. **JWT** — HS256, 24h expiry, `JWT_SECRET` env var
3. **Sessions** — Refresh tokens (30-day expiry)
4. **API Keys** — `Zorux_` prefix, 64-byte random, optional expiry
5. **OAuth/Social** — 36 providers (Google, GitHub, Discord, Apple, etc.)
6. **Magic Link** — Email-based passwordless (15-min expiry)
7. **Email OTP** — 6-digit code (10-min expiry)
8. **WebAuthn** — FIDO2 passkeys/biometrics
9. **2FA/TOTP** — Google Authenticator compatible

### Auth Headers

```
Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>
Authorization: Bearer Zorux_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx...  # API key
Cookie: token=<jwt-token>
```

### OAuth Providers (36)

google, github, discord, apple, atlassian, cognito, dropbox, facebook, figma, gitlab, huggingface, kakao, kick, line, linear, linkedin, microsoft, naver, notion, paybin, paypal, polar, railway, reddit, roblox, salesforce, slack, spotify, tiktok, twitch, twitter, vercel, vk, wechat, zoom, huawei

---

## DATABASE

### Providers

| Provider | Description |
|---|---|
| `sqlite` | Local file (default), WAL mode, prepared statement cache |
| `:memory:` | In-memory SQLite (testing) |
| `postgres` | PostgreSQL via `postgres` npm package |
| `mysql` | MySQL via `mysql2/promise` |
| `mongodb` | MongoDB via `mongodb` npm package |
| `cloudflare-d1` | Cloudflare D1 via REST API |
| `supabase` | Supabase PostgreSQL |

### System Tables

`_migrations`, `_sessions`, `_audit_logs`, `_notifications`, `_feature_flags`, `_webhooks`, `_social_accounts`, `_oauth_clients`, `_oauth_codes`, `_oauth_tokens`, `_webauthn_credentials`, `_totp_secrets`, `_auth_tokens`, `_api_keys`, `_organizations`, `_org_members`, `_org_invites`, `_kai_jobs`

## CACHE

### Providers

| Provider | Env Vars |
|---|---|
| `memory` | — |
| `redis` | `REDIS_URL` |
| `upstash` | `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL`, `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` |
| `memcached` | `MEMCACHED_HOST`, `MEMCACHED_PORT` |
| `dynamodb` | `DYNAMODB_CACHE_TABLE`, `AWS_REGION` |
| `sqlite` | `SQLITE_CACHE_PATH` |
| `cf-kv` | `CF_ACCOUNT_ID`, `CF_KV_NAMESPACE_ID`, `CF_API_TOKEN` |
| `cf-do` | `CF_DO_NAMESPACE_ID` |

### Auto-Caching

GET responses cached by URL. Invalidated on POST/PUT/DELETE. Headers: `X-Cache: HIT` or `X-Cache: MISS`.

---

## STORAGE

### Providers

| Provider | Description |
|---|---|
| `local` | `public/uploads/{table}/{timestamp}-{random}.{ext}` |
| `s3` | AWS S3, MinIO, R2, Spaces — any S3-compatible |
| `supabase` | Supabase Storage |

### S3 Env Vars

`S3_ENDPOINT`, `S3_REGION`, `S3_BUCKET`, `S3_ACCESS_KEY`, `S3_SECRET_KEY`

### File Validation

- MIME type detection
- Blocked extensions: `.exe, .bat, .cmd, .com, .scr, .pif, .msi, .js, .vbs, .wsf, .php, .py, .rb, .pl, .sh`
- Filename sanitization (path traversal, null bytes)

## EMAIL

### Providers

| Provider | Env Vars | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fake` | — | In-memory sandbox, viewable at `/admin/emails` |
| `log` | — | Console.log only |
| `resend` | `RESEND_API_KEY` | Resend API |
| `sendgrid` | `SENDGRID_API_KEY` | SendGrid API |
| `smtp` | `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS` | SMTP via Nodemailer |

### API

```typescript
sendEmail({
  to: "user@example.com" | ["a@x.com", "b@x.com"],
  subject: "Hello",
  text: "Plain text",
  html: "<h1>HTML</h1>",
  from: "custom@from.com"  // optional
})
```

---

## BACKGROUND JOBS

Jobs defined in `jobs/*.ts`, auto-loaded.

```typescript
// jobs/send-email.ts
export default {
  name: "send-email",
  async perform(args: { email: string; subject: string }, context: any) {
    await sendEmail(args)
  }
}
```

### Submit

```bash
POST /api/jobs/:name/submit
{ "args": { ... }, "delay": 3600, "maxRetries": 5 }
```

### Features

- Persistent queue in `_kai_jobs` table
- Statuses: pending, running, completed, failed
- Retry: exponential backoff (5s, 10s, 20s...), max 3 retries (configurable)
- Delayed scheduling via `scheduled_at`
- Worker polls every 1000ms, up to 10 jobs per tick


## REAL-TIME

### WebSocket

```
ws://localhost:3000/ws
```

Client sends: `{ "subscribe": "posts" }`
Server pushes: `{ "topic": "posts:created", "data": { ... } }`

### Auto-Publish

CRUD operations auto-publish: `{tableName}:created`, `{tableName}:updated`, `{tableName}:deleted`, `{tableName}:restored`

### Pub/Sub

```typescript
subscribe("posts", (data) => { ... })
publish("posts:created", { id: 1, title: "Hello" })
publishMany(["posts", "notifications"], { ... })
```

---

## WEBHOOKS

### Register

```bash
POST /api/webhooks
{ "url": "https://myapp.com/webhook", "events": "posts.created,posts.updated", "secret": "my-secret" }
```

Events: `*` (all), `posts.*` (all post events), `posts.created` (specific)

### Payload

```json
{
  "event": "posts:created",
  "model": "posts",
  "data": { ... },
  "timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

### Signing

HMAC-SHA256 of `JSON.stringify(payload) + secret`
Headers: `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=...`, `X-Webhook-Event: posts:created`

---

## PLUGINS

### Interface

```typescript
interface KaiPlugin {
  name: string
  version?: string
  description?: string
  dependsOn?: string[]
  onConfig?: (config: AppConfig) => AppConfig
  onModel?: (models) => models
  onCompiledModel?: (models, config) => models
  onSchema?: (schema, model) => string
  onRoutes?: (app: Hono, platform) => void
  onMiddleware?: (app: Hono) => void
  onDBQuery?: (query) => query
  onError?: (error, context) => Response | void
  onStart?: (platform) => void
  onShutdown?: () => void
}
```

### Loading

- Local: `plugins/{name}.ts` or `plugins/{name}/index.ts`
- npm: tries exact name, then `kai-plugin-{name}`

### 12 Auto-Detect Adapters

Native KaiPlugin, Hono middleware, Express middleware/Router/app, Passport Strategy, install() hook, setup()/init()/register() hooks, Koa middleware, Fastify plugin, namespace with middleware exports, class with handle()

---

## SECURITY

### ABAC/RBAC Policy Engine

Recursive descent parser. Operators: `==`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `&&`, `||`, `!`, `in`, `matches`, `contains`, `exists`

Scopes: `user.*`, `resource.*`, `env.*`

AST cache for expressions under 500 chars.

### Security Headers

`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `Strict-Transport-Security` (production), `Content-Security-Policy`

### Rate Limiter

200 requests per 60-second window. Token bucket. Keyed by `X-Forwarded-For` or `X-Real-IP`. Headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`

### CSRF

Token store with 1-hour TTL. `csrf_session` cookie. `X-CSRF-Token` header. Skipped for `multipart/form-data`.

### Body Size Limit

1MB default. Returns 413 if exceeded.

### Input Sanitization

Filename sanitization (path traversal, null bytes). HTML escaping. JSON depth limit (20). Null byte removal. Control character removal.

### Cookie Hardening

`HttpOnly`, `Secure` (production), `SameSite=Strict` (production) / `Lax` (dev)

### Audit Log

Every create/update/delete logged to `_audit_logs`: user, model, record_id, old/new values, IP. Queryable via `GET /api/audit-logs`.

---

## GRAPHQL

Auto-generated from models.

### Queries

```graphql
{ post(id: 1) { id title body } }
{ postsList(page: 1, limit: 10, search: "hello", sort: "title", order: "asc") { rows { id title } total page limit } }
```

### Mutations

```graphql
mutation { createPost(data: { title: "Hello", body: "World", authorId: 1 }) { id title } }
mutation { updatePost(id: 1, data: { title: "Updated" }) { id title } }
mutation { deletePost(id: 1) { id } }
```

### Type Mapping

`int`/`bool` → `Int`, `float` → `Float`, `string`/`text`/`email`/`file` → `String`

---

## MOBILE (EXPO)

```bash
zorux gen mobile
```

Generates full Expo project with:
- Typed SDK per model
- Auth screens (login, register, OAuth)
- Per-model CRUD screens (list, create, edit)
- Realtime WebSocket hook
- ImagePicker for file uploads
- Pull-to-refresh
- Form validation UI

---

## DESKTOP (TAURI)

```bash
zorux gen desktop
```

Generates Tauri v2 project with:
- Rust backend (`src-tauri/`)
- Connects to `localhost:3000` (dev) or production URL
- Native menus, system tray, file dialogs
- Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux

---

## PWA

```bash
zorux gen pwa
```

Generates:
- `manifest.json` with icons
- `sw.js` service worker (network-first caching)
- Auto-registration on admin pages

---

## I18N

```yaml
i18n:
  defaultLocale: en
  locales: [en, pt-BR, es, fr]
  cookieName: lang
```

Translation files: `locales/{locale}.json`

```typescript
t(key: string, vars?: Record<string, string | number>, locale?: string): string
```

Locale detection: `lang` query param → `lang` cookie → `Accept-Language` header → default

## TELEMETRY

### Metrics

```typescript
const counter = new Counter("http_requests_total", "Total requests")
counter.add(1, { method: "GET", path: "/api/posts" })

const histogram = new Histogram("http_request_duration_ms", "Duration")
histogram.record(45)
```

### Tracing

```typescript
const span = startSpan("process-payment", { orderId: "123" })
addSpanEvent(span, "payment-initiated")
endSpan(span, "ok")
```

### Exporters

Console (stdout), OTLP (`OTLP_ENDPOINT` env var)

### Metrics Endpoint

`GET /api/metrics` — Prometheus text format

## DEPLOY

### Docker

```bash
zorux deploy docker    # Generates Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml
```

### Vercel

```bash
zorux deploy vercel    # Generates vercel.json
# Use PostgreSQL, not SQLite. WebSocket not supported.
```

### Netlify

```bash
zorux deploy netlify   # Generates netlify.toml
# Use PostgreSQL. WebSocket not supported.
```

### Cloudflare Workers

```bash
zorux deploy cloudflare  # Generates wrangler.toml
# Uses D1 (database), KV (cache), Queues (jobs)
```

---

## ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES

### Required

`JWT_SECRET` — Change from default in production!

### Database

`DATABASE_URL` — Connection string

### Cache

`REDIS_URL`, `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL`, `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN`, `MEMCACHED_HOST`, `MEMCACHED_PORT`, `DYNAMODB_CACHE_TABLE`, `AWS_REGION`, `SQLITE_CACHE_PATH`, `CF_ACCOUNT_ID`, `CF_KV_NAMESPACE_ID`, `CF_API_TOKEN`, `CF_DO_NAMESPACE_ID`

### Email

`RESEND_API_KEY`, `SENDGRID_API_KEY`, `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_SECURE`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS`

### Storage

`S3_ENDPOINT`, `S3_REGION`, `S3_BUCKET`, `S3_ACCESS_KEY`, `S3_SECRET_KEY`

### Payments

`STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `POLAR_TOKEN`

### OAuth

`GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID`, `GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET`, etc.

### Captcha

`TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY`, `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`, `RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY`, `RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY`

### Telemetry

`OTLP_ENDPOINT`

---

## PROJECT STRUCTURE

```
my-app/
├── app.yaml              # Single source of truth
├── actions/              # Custom action handlers (*.ts)
├── jobs/                 # Background job definitions (*.ts)
├── plugins/              # Local plugins (*.ts or */index.ts)
├── migrations/           # Database migrations (*.sql or *.ts)
├── locales/              # i18n translation files (*.json)
├── public/
│   └── uploads/          # Uploaded files (local storage)
├── db/
│   └── app.db            # SQLite database (auto-created)
└── package.json
```

---

## CUSTOM ACTIONS

```typescript
// actions/greet.ts
export const hello = F.public(async (ctx) => {
  return F.json({ message: "Hello!" })
})

export const protected_action = F.auth(async (ctx) => {
  const user = ctx.get("user")
  return F.json({ user })
})

export const admin_only = F.role("admin").run(async (ctx) => {
  return F.json({ admin: true })
})
```

Routes: `ALL /api/actions/greet/hello`, `ALL /api/actions/greet/protected_action`, etc.

### F Object

```typescript
F.public(handler)      // No auth required
F.auth(handler)        // Must be logged in
F.role("admin").run(handler)  // Must have role
F.owner("authorId").run(handler)  // Must own resource
F.html(strings, ...values)  // HTML response
F.json(data)           // JSON response
```

---

## COMPLETE EXAMPLE

```yaml
name: blog-platform
type: fullstack
database:
  provider: postgres
  url: "postgres://postgres:pass@localhost:5432/blog"

models:
  User:
    fields:
      name: string required
      email: email required unique
      avatar: file
      role: string enum:admin,editor,subscriber default:subscriber
    auth: password
    timestamps: true

  Post:
    fields:
      title: string required min:3 max:200
      slug: string unique
      body: text required
      status: string enum:draft,published default:draft
      coverImage: file
      author: User
      category: Category
      tags: Tag[]
    timestamps: true
    policies:
      list: public
      read: public
      create: authenticated
      update: owner
      delete: admin

  Category:
    fields:
      name: string required unique
      description: text
    timestamps: true

  Tag:
    fields:
      name: string required unique
    timestamps: true

  Comment:
    fields:
      body: text required
      author: User
      post: Post
    timestamps: true
    policies:
      create: authenticated
      update: owner
      delete: "user.role == 'admin' || resource.authorId == user.id"

auth:
  model: User
  registration: open
  roles: [admin, editor, subscriber]
  defaultRole: subscriber
  social:
    google:
      clientId: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}
      clientSecret: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}
    github:
      clientId: ${GITHUB_CLIENT_ID}
      clientSecret: ${GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET}

cache:
  provider: redis
  url: ${REDIS_URL}
  ttl: 120

storage:
  provider: s3
  s3:
    bucket: blog-uploads
    region: us-east-1

email:
  provider: resend
  from: "noreply@blog.com"

realtime:
  enabled: true

search:
  provider: meilisearch
  url: http://localhost:7700

i18n:
  defaultLocale: en
  locales: [en, pt-BR]

theme:
  framework: tailwind
  primary: "#3b82f6"
  mode: dark
```

---

## KEY DESIGN DECISIONS

1. **Single source of truth** — `app.yaml` is the exclusive DSL. No separate route files, config files, or migration scripts.
2. **Convention over configuration** — Model names pluralized for tables. Relations create FKs automatically. Auth model gets password field and auth routes.
3. **Lazy optional dependencies** — All optional packages `require()`d inside function bodies, not at module scope.
4. **Provider-agnostic interfaces** — DatabaseAdapter, CacheAdapter, StorageProvider, EmailProvider, PaymentProvider. Switch by changing one YAML line.
5. **UUID v7 default** — RFC 9562, time-ordered, cryptographically random suffix.
6. **Plugin routes after admin** — Plugins can override admin routes.
7. **bun:sqlite** — Uses `bun:sqlite` directly, not better-sqlite3.
8. **Bun native WebSocket** — `Bun.serve()` with websocket option. No external packages.
9. **Hot reload via fs.watch** — Watches app.yaml, actions/, jobs/, plugins/, locales/, views/. 300ms debounce.
